provenance.calibration_sha256_semantics: Compatibility field: SDK API document identity, NOT a physical calibration
provenance.speed_mapping: The sole writer applies the existing continuous V4 static map, with no second time filter. The planar input ceiling is 50 percent per the operator's 2026-10-16 request; the response shape and near-zero blend remain, and the nominal SI command limit remains 0.30 m/s. SDK percentage is not a measured physical speed. Yaw retains its continuous operating range from the observed 20 percent response knee toward 30 percent at full demand; it is not the former fixed 20 percent relay. The wider near-zero blend reduces amplification of tiny heading noise. One tracker conditioner jointly shapes SI demands and their SDK image; no correction/settling state, forced canonical yaw, or assumed physical inertia. These values are engineering response parameters, not a measured speed or angular-rate calibration. Original cancellation, source expiry and control-loss semantics remain.

provenance.bounds: Configured low-speed planning margins and stopping/source-age budgets; NOT measured upper bounds or verified braking guarantees
provenance.stationary_velocity: Fresh confirmed GENERAL low-speed operation, and fresh confirmed fixed STAIR only when general_runtime_reuse explicitly selects this same runtime profile, check the original XY norm and absolute body-Z independently at the existing 0.03 m/s threshold; angular motion keeps the original 3D 0.05 rad/s norm. The selected standing state, low-speed gear and head direction must match. Other, transitioning, unknown or stale modes use the original spatial norm. The raw 3D norm is always reported. The 1 s source-time stop window, real zero acknowledgement and drained SDK writes remain required. MC static bias and capture-delay bounds remain physically uncalibrated; this is a metric contract, not acceptance evidence.
